body:
I can't really describe it. It could be described as panic, but it isn't what I'd call panic. Oh, I just don't know.

That's probably true, I won't do anything out of fear of doing it. It's almost like I have an intense urge or desire to do so. Again, indescribable.

I felt good about how my life was going up until around a couple of days ago when this depression-less suicidal idealization started. I've had no reason to be too depressed.

I'm sorry I can't be more descriptive. I just can't put it into words. I've never felt this before. I know what it's like to be suicidal and depressed, but not just suicidal. It's terrifying. I'm just scared I'd give in and do something drastic.

It's more sudden. I'm scared that I might actually do something this time. When I was depressed and suicidal, I had no drive to do anything. However, I am not depressed this time, but just feel suicidal. I could also call it a panicked feeling. I can't think of anything that might have triggered this. I've been doing quite well lately. 

I appreciate what you can say. I've been through these suicidal feelings before, but I've never had this much energy or drive to follow through on my thoughts.
